get.summary: Every code the system emits: kind, Chinese name, meaning, the rule that emits it and its document section
get.description: Filter with kind (IDENTITY_REASON, EVIDENCE_DETAIL, DATA_QUALITY, PROBLEM, …). A value with detail attached (SOFT_DIFFERENCE（…）, ENCODING_FALLBACK:<file>) is listed under its key. HIT and UNKNOWN serve several kinds and are listed once, under CONDITION_STATUS.

get.summary: One code; a value with detail attached is looked up by its key
get.description: The meaning of a code found in a response: its kind, Chinese name, meaning, the rule that emits it and the document section that defines the rule in full.

get.summary: Names of the published JSON Schemas and the schema version
get.description: The schema names of the stored records and views, and the current schemaVersion.

get.summary: JSON Schema of a stored record: field descriptions, and x-sensitivity (PERSONAL, IDENTIFIER) on personal data
get.description: Validates or interprets a stored record or a view. x-sensitivity (personal data) is published only here, for the schemas GET /api/schemas names.

post.summary: Create a Case from the export files and run the first analysis; 201 when created, 200 when it already existed
post.description: Send multipart form fields subjectRef, triggerEventId and files (案件資訊*.txt, 名單資料_<id>.txt, the customer or related-party files and any 新聞資訊_<id>.txt, or the same pages as HTML), or JSON {subjectRef, triggerEventId, files: {name: text}} as one batch item. One Case per alert (trigger event and subject): repeating the same triggerEventId and subjectRef returns the existing Case with 200. Returns the Case summary with links to its hits and its full revision. Example: GC-03 gives result REVIEW with one hit, DJ:90000031, identityDecision PROBABLE_MATCH.

example.conclusion: 案件結果 REVIEW（revision 1）：1 個 hit，1 個需複核
案件結果 REVIEW（revision 1）：1 個 hit，1 個需複核

get.summary: Find Cases by subject and/or trigger event, oldest first, one page at a time
get.description: Give subjectRef, triggerEventId or both. Returns one page of Cases and nextPageToken when more follow; pass it back as pageToken.

post.summary: Run a new analysis revision with updated input files; returns the Case summary
post.description: Send the full set of export files again, as multipart, as for POST /api/cases, when the bank files of an existing Case changed. A changed list Profile needs no call: POST /api/profiles/import queues that re-analysis. A revision that is not complete does not replace the effective result.

get.summary: One Case: view=full (default) with the full record of its effective revision, view=summary with the result, a conclusion and one line per hit
get.description: view=full returns the Case and the full record of its effective revision: result, explanation, lineage and data quality, with identifier values. view=summary holds no identifier values and, of personal data, only names; hits are ordered by review priority, at most 10 are listed and the rest counted in omitted. Example (view=summary): GC-03 gives result REVIEW with one hit, DJ:90000031, identityDecision PROBABLE_MATCH.

value.conclusion: 案件結果 REVIEW（revision 1）：1 個 hit，1 個需複核

get.summary: One hit of the effective revision (or ?revision=): view=detail (default) with the full explanation, view=summary without compared values
get.description: view=detail returns the hit explanation with the compared subject and Profile values. view=summary gives the decisive evidence, reason codes and wouldChangeIf without values. wouldChangeIf names the stage 3 row a comparable document or full DOB would move the identity decision to; it never states an external result. Codes are explained at /api/codes/{code}. Example (view=summary): GC-03 hit 1 has sourceConditions [OFFICIAL_WANTED_LIST], identityDecision PROBABLE_MATCH at stage 3 row 4 and pairResult REVIEW.

wouldChangeIf.text: 若同類證件相符：身分判斷移至第三階段第 2 列 UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER_AGREEMENT
若同類證件不符：身分判斷移至第三階段第 1 列 DOCUMENT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT
若完整出生日期不符：身分判斷移至第三階段第 1 列 FULL_DOB_CONFLICT

get.summary: A Case's candidate Profiles: source=table (CONTROLLED_SET, its own candidate table, the default) or source=previous (PREVIOUS_LINK, the Profiles of its latest input)
get.description: The Profiles a Case was screened against. truncated marks a list cut by top.

get.summary: Every analysis revision: time, execution status, result, whether it is effective and how many changes it made
get.description: The analysis history of a Case and which revision is effective.

get.summary: The full record of one revision: result, explanation, lineage and data quality
get.description: The audit record: nothing is left out, so it holds identifier values. Lineage gives the input file hashes, the Profile versions and the rule versions. Field meanings are in /api/schemas/revision, codes at /api/codes/{code}.

post.description: Each item has subjectRef, triggerEventId and files (file name → text content), the same inputs as POST /api/cases. Items already queued under the same triggerEventId and subjectRef are listed as duplicates and not queued again. Returns 202 with batchId; progress is at GET /api/batches/{batchId}.

get.summary: Batch progress: counts per status and one page of items with their Case, revision, attempts and error code
get.description: The progress of a submitted batch or of the re-analyses a Profile import queued. view=summary (default) lists the items not yet succeeded; view=full lists every item; status= lists one status. Items come oldest first, pageSize (default 20, at most 100) at a time, with nextPageToken when more follow.

post.summary: Operator re-run: dead-lettered items of the batch go back to the queue with a fresh retry budget
post.description: For transient failures (TIMEOUT, LEASE_EXPIRED, EXCEPTION:<type>) after their cause is fixed. Every dead-lettered item is requeued; INVALID_INPUT and INVALID_PAYLOAD fail the same way again, so fixed files for INVALID_INPUT go to POST /api/cases. Returns how many items were requeued.

post.summary: Capture Profiles into the list database; a changed Profile queues re-analysis of the Cases that used it
post.description: Upload 名單資料_<id>.txt (or .html). An unchanged file keeps its version; a changed one becomes a new version, the old one is kept, and every Case whose latest input used it gets a queued re-analysis job under the returned batchId (GET /api/batches/{batchId}). A file whose name and Profile_ID differ, or one Profile in two formats, is rejected. A Case's own files are sent with POST /api/cases.

get.summary: Search the list database by name (INDEX_SEARCH)
get.description: Counted by Profile, not alias row; exact alias matches come first and are never cut. The score ranks candidates only; it is never an identity probability.

get.summary: Profiles that describe the same person: shared document key or recorded source link, never name similarity
get.description: Groups list each accepted merge as an edge with its basis; merges refused for a DOB or gender conflict are listed under rejected. Merges never come from name similarity.

get.summary: One captured Profile (DIRECT_REFERENCE): view=full (default) as read, view=summary without identifier values; the latest version, or ?version=; the ID may carry the DJ: prefix
get.description: view=full returns the Profile as read, with dates of birth, documents, addresses and sources. view=summary gives who a Profile is and why it is listed: names, gender, citizenship, categories, roles and the official-list entry. Both carry the version, latest version and content hash.

get.summary: Every captured version of one Profile, with its content hash
get.description: When a Profile changed; the content of a version is at GET /api/profiles/{profileId}?version=.
